_comment: Editor-session proposals for the cross-manager pass (x7). Each passage is the filing's own words, located byte for byte by the runner; nothing here is published until a person reviews it.

0001104659-22-067534#0.paraphrase: Harris argues that Netflix's slower subscriber growth and margin pressure, the latter mainly from weak foreign currencies, are likely temporary, and that at 5.5x 2022 revenue and 34x earnings the shares are compelling.
0001104659-22-067534#0.evidenceExcerpt: Weak foreign currencies in the company's international markets were the primary source of margin pressure.

risk.description: Weaker foreign currencies pressure margins, since most costs are in dollars

0001104659-22-067534#0.paraphrase: Harris says the market values Meta as if it will barely grow after Apple's privacy changes hit targeted advertising, which it calls misguided, and it sold put options to add exposure.
0001104659-22-067534#0.evidenceExcerpt: We sold put options to add to our economic exposure in Meta to take advantage of the price weakness.

risk.description: Apple's privacy policies have hurt the targeted advertising business

0001104659-22-121775#1.paraphrase: After a 35% fall, Harris says Capital One trades at 5.2x forward earnings and 1.07x tangible book, an unreasonably low valuation for an above-average lender, and bought it.
0001104659-22-121775#1.evidenceExcerpt: We believe this is an unreasonably low valuation for what we see as an above-average financial institution.

risk.description: Loan losses will normalise to a higher level over time

0001104659-22-121775#1.paraphrase: Harris bought Intercontinental Exchange, arguing its three segments should grow earnings well above GDP while the stock trades at roughly the market multiple.
0001104659-22-121775#1.evidenceExcerpt: think Intercontinental Exchange represents a compelling opportunity

0001104659-22-121775#0.paraphrase: Harris says Charter's fundamentals matched its expectations despite slowing broadband growth, and it increased the position by more than 25% in the quarter.
0001104659-22-121775#0.evidenceExcerpt: increase our position in Charter by more than 25%

0001104659-22-121775#0.paraphrase: Harris argues the market's assumptions on Charter are overly punitive: it remains the dominant broadband provider in 60% of its footprint and should keep growing operating profit.
0001104659-22-121775#0.evidenceExcerpt: Charter remains the dominant broadband provider in 60% of its footprint

risk.description: Competition and concerns about broadband subscriber growth

0001104659-23-064651#0.paraphrase: After the Silicon Valley Bank collapse, Harris argues fears about Schwab's securities losses are overstated, citing deposits spread across more than 34 million mostly insured accounts and strong liquidity, and added it to Oakmark Select.
0001104659-23-064651#0.evidenceExcerpt: We believe these concerns are overstated

risk.description: Deposit outflows and mark-to-market losses will weigh on near-term earnings

0001104659-23-064651#0.paraphrase: Harris kept buying Capital One at about 6x 2023 consensus earnings and below tangible book, arguing it does not share the failed banks' balance-sheet risks.
0001104659-23-064651#0.evidenceExcerpt: despite not sharing the balance sheet risks

0001104659-23-064651#0.paraphrase: Harris initiated Intercontinental Exchange, arguing only 7% of revenue depends on mortgage volumes and the shares trade at a discount to exchange peers.
0001104659-23-064651#0.evidenceExcerpt: only 7% of trailing 12-month revenues are sensitive to mortgage volumes

risk.description: The mortgage segment will be pressured while rates depress origination volumes

0001104659-23-064651#0.paraphrase: Harris sold Netflix from Oakmark Select to fund purchases it judged more attractive, while saying the shares sold remained undervalued.
0001104659-23-064651#0.evidenceExcerpt: We sold our holdings in Allison Transmission, Citigroup and Netflix.

0001104659-23-064651#0.paraphrase: Harris calls Alphabet its largest holding, arguing Google search deserves a premium multiple and that investors misread ChatGPT as a sign Google was behind on AI.

risk.description: Generative AI could take search share

0001104659-23-120835#0.paraphrase: Harris argues most of Phillips 66's value lies outside refining, so even if refining margins normalise it is paying a single-digit multiple of normalised earnings, with most free cash flow returned to shareholders.
0001104659-23-120835#0.evidenceExcerpt: we believe we are paying a single-digit multiple of normalized earnings

risk.description: Today's refining margins are abnormally high and may not last

0001104659-23-120835#0.paraphrase: Harris notes Charter added 77,000 broadband subscribers in Q2 2023 against consensus of 13,000 and more than 600,000 mobile lines in each of three quarters, and argues faster unit growth, though it holds back near-term earnings, will prove valuable.
0001104659-23-120835#0.evidenceExcerpt: mobile net adds were strong at 648,000, and net adds have been over 600,000

0001104659-24-065556#0.paraphrase: Harris expects Charter's broadband growth to stay hard near term, with more competition and a government subsidy winding down, but to recover while the company grows earnings and buys back stock.
0001104659-24-065556#0.evidenceExcerpt: We maintain our belief in the long-term prospects of Charter Communications.

risk.description: Fiber overbuilding and fixed wireless competition

0001104659-24-065556#0.paraphrase: Harris sold Liberty Broadband to realise tax losses and added about the same amount of Charter, treating the two as largely substitutable since Liberty's main asset is its Charter stake.
